FaqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
FaqPage.intro: Everything you need to know before ordering. Can't find your answer? Message us.

q1.q: How do I place an order?
q1.a: For now, message us on WhatsApp with the pick-up point, the drop-off point, the size of your item and the recipient's name and phone number. Online ordering is coming soon.

q2.a: We deliver across Greater Lomé. Beyond 30 km, ask us for a quote on WhatsApp.

q3.q: How much does a delivery cost?
q3.a: The price depends on the road distance: 300 FCFA pick-up fee + 150 FCFA per kilometre, with a minimum of 500 FCFA. A surcharge applies to medium (+ 200 FCFA) and large (+ 500 FCFA) items. The total is rounded up to the next 100 FCFA.

q4.a: Payment is cash only, on delivery. Mobile Money payment is not available yet.

q5.a: For an immediate delivery, it usually takes 30 to 60 minutes, depending on distance.

q6.a: Yes. Choose the date and time, at least 1 hour ahead and up to 7 days.

q7.a: You can order 7 days a week, at any time.

q8.a: Yes, cancellation is free as long as the order has not yet been assigned to a courier.

q9.q: Are there items you don't deliver?
q9.a: Yes: illegal, dangerous or flammable products, weapons, live animals and large sums of money.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.metaDescription: How Sob Livraison collects, uses and protects your personal data.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Sob Livraison is a delivery service in Lomé (Togo). We are responsible for the personal data collected through this website and our contact channels.
For any question about your data: {email} or {phone}.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: When you contact us (WhatsApp, phone, email): your name, phone number and the content of your messages.
When you place an order: pick-up and drop-off addresses and locations, the recipient's name and phone number, and a description of the item.
When you create an account (coming soon): your name, phone number, email and password (stored encrypted).
When you visit: anonymous traffic statistics (Vercel Analytics), with no advertising cookies.

sections.title: Why we use your data
paragraphs: To process and deliver your orders, contact you about a delivery, answer your questions and improve our service.
We never sell your data and never use it for advertising.

sections.title: Who can access it
paragraphs: The Sob Livraison team and the courier handling your delivery, who only receives the information needed for the delivery.
Our technical providers, only to run the service: the website host (Vercel), the database (Supabase, once accounts are available) and WhatsApp (Meta) when you message us there.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Order data is kept for 3 years after your last order, then deleted.
Contact messages are kept for 1 year.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under Togolese Law No. 2019-014 of 29 October 2019 on the protection of personal data, you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, and object to its use.
To exercise these rights, email us at {email}. You can also contact the Personal Data Protection Authority (IPDCP).

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Your data is transmitted securely (HTTPS) and access is limited to the people who need it.

sections.title: Cookies and storage
paragraphs: The website only stores what it needs to work: your language and your theme (light or dark). No advertising cookies are used.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: This policy may change. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.

Terms.title: Terms and conditions
Terms.metaDescription: Terms of use and sale of the Sob Livraison delivery service in Lomé.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: These terms govern the use of the Sob Livraison website and the sale of our delivery services. Placing an order means you accept them.

sections.title: Services
paragraphs: Sob Livraison delivers parcels and documents, meals and groceries across Greater Lomé, immediately or at a scheduled time.

sections.title: Orders
paragraphs: Orders are placed on WhatsApp, and soon directly on the website. You must provide accurate information: pick-up and drop-off points, item size, and the recipient's name and phone number.
An order is final once confirmed by Sob Livraison. A scheduled delivery must be requested at least 1 hour ahead, and up to 7 days.

sections.title: Prices
paragraphs: The price is based on the road distance: a pick-up fee + a price per kilometre, with a minimum price and a surcharge depending on the item size. It is rounded up to the next 100 FCFA.
The price is given before the order is confirmed. Beyond 30 km, a specific quote is provided.

sections.title: Payment
paragraphs: Payment is made in cash to the courier, on delivery.
For meals and groceries, you pay the seller for your purchases yourself, unless agreed otherwise with Sob Livraison.

sections.title: Delivery times
paragraphs: Announced times (30 to 60 minutes on average for an immediate delivery) are estimates and may vary with traffic and weather.

sections.title: Cancellation
paragraphs: Cancellation is free as long as the order has not been assigned to a courier. After that, contact us quickly and we will find a solution together.

sections.title: Your commitments
paragraphs: You and the recipient must be reachable by phone during the delivery. Items must be properly packed.
You must not entrust Sob Livraison with illegal, dangerous or flammable products, weapons, live animals or large sums of money. Sob Livraison may refuse any non-compliant item.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: Sob Livraison takes care of your items. If there is a problem (significant delay, damage or loss), contact us no later than 24 hours after the planned delivery: each case will be reviewed to find a solution.
Sob Livraison is not responsible for the content of items, nor for delays caused by events beyond its control (bad weather, closed roads, etc.).

sections.title: Personal data
paragraphs: Your data is processed in accordance with our privacy policy.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Togolese law. In case of dispute, we will first seek an amicable solution; failing that, the competent courts of Lomé will have jurisdiction.
Contact: {phone} — {email}
